speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma.

Based on your history as a 62-year-old heavy smoker with non-healing, crusty lesions on both the penis and a finger that have not responded to previous treatments, this clinical picture is highly suggestive of squamous cell carcinoma.
